{{Top|leg}}
'''Werris eggs''' were a variety of [[Egg/Legends|egg]] served at the [[Kragget/Legends|Kragget]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Mij Gilamar]] ordered a plate of fried werris eggs at the Kragget as part of his breakfast.<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
Werris eggs first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' novel [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[September 16]], [[2008]].
